request.deadline: Period of delivery is stated as instant upon enactment on-chain
deliverables: Instant on-chain distribution as part of governance action enactment
request.recipient: Ikigai Info governance action submitter; specific recipient address not stated in document
request.what: Reimburse the lost deposit for the Ikigai Info governance action, plus additional ADA intended to compensate for lost staking rewards.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 103,000 ADA from the treasury to reimburse a 100,000 ADA lost governance action deposit plus 3,000 ADA for estimated lost staking rewards.
The proposer says the original Ikigai Info governance action was a symbolic action thanking contributors and expressing hope for Cardano's future.
The proposer says a Cardano node bug allowed an unregistered stake key to be used in the governance action, preventing the submitter from recovering the 100,000 ADA deposit.
The document includes an external reference to an AdaStat governance action page for the Ikigai action.
The proposer says there was significant community sentiment that the Ikigai deposit should be reimbursed because the submitter was an early pioneer of Cardano governance.
The proposer says no entity-based budget submission included this reimbursement after treasury withdrawals became available following the Plomin hard fork.
The proposer says the Cardano in Oceania initiative included the reimbursement in its budget Info governance action, but that governance action was not approved.
The proposer asserts the recipient has not previously received treasury funds.
The proposer asserts the requested amount does not exceed the current Net Change Limit.
The proposer states there are no circumstances under which the withdrawal might be refunded to the Cardano Treasury.

summary: The document requests a 103,000 ADA treasury withdrawal to reimburse a lost Ikigai Info governance action deposit and estimated staking rewards, but most key justifications are asserted with limited supporting analysis.
